item.title: 2 found fatally shot in Brighton Park
item.description: <p>A man and woman were found fatally shot in Brighton Park Wednesday night, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The man, 70, and the woman, 43, were found inside a residence in the 4500 block of South Albany Avenue at 8:03 p.m. by officers responding to a call of two people who were shot, police said in a statement. </p><p>The woman was shot in the face and the man was shot in the head, police said. Both were pronounced dead at the scene.</p><p>No one is in custody, police said.</p>
